title: Financial psychology
learning_outcomes: Explain present bias in the context of financial psychology.
Compare and distinguish social pressure in the context of financial psychology.
Apply decision checklist in the context of financial psychology.
Evaluate and justify decisions about trade-offs in the context of financial psychology.

lessons.title: Present bias
lessons.outcome: Explain present bias in the context of financial psychology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving present bias; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to financial decision journal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain present bias from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of present bias; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Social pressure
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish social pressure in the context of financial psychology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving social pressure; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to financial decision journal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain social pressure from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of social pressure; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Decision checklist
lessons.outcome: Apply decision checklist in the context of financial psychology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving decision checklist; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to financial decision journal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain decision checklist from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of decision checklist; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Trade-offs
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about trade-offs in the context of financial psychology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving trade-offs; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to financial decision journal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain trade-offs from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of trade-offs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of present bias; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of social pressure; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of decision checklist; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of trade-offs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
